memory auto status.authorization: Read automatic sleep settings and run-local scheduler activity

xhs note preflight.authorization: Read and check explicitly supplied local note files

xhs note open.authorization: Open a new background creator tab in the selected Xiaohongshu container; local loopback fixture only when specified
xhs note open.output: opening, login-required, verification-required, account-unverified, account-ready, unsupported-form
xhs note open.compatibility: Requires xhsNoteProtocol 1 in Ecom on macOS. Loopback fixtures require Ecom Dev.

xhs note status.authorization: Inspect a pinned tab, creator identity or saved submission attempt
xhs note status.output: Preparation ID, account ID, image and field readback, review readiness, or submission evidence for the legacy flow
xhs note status.compatibility: Requires xhsNoteProtocol 1 in Ecom on macOS. Loopback fixtures require Ecom Dev.

xhs note prepare.authorization: Upload ordered image bytes and fill a blank composer; may create platform draft state; never clicks Publish
xhs note prepare.output: uploading, form-ready with confirmation, or specific unavailable/changed state
xhs note prepare.compatibility: Requires xhsNoteProtocol 1 in Ecom on macOS. Loopback fixtures require Ecom Dev.

xhs note submit.authorization: Explicitly publish the reviewed ordinary image note once; unknown results require status or creator note management review
xhs note submit.output: not-submitted, submitted, published with note ID, or submission-unknown
xhs note submit.compatibility: Requires xhsNoteProtocol 1 in Ecom on macOS. Loopback fixtures require Ecom Dev.

page read.authorization: Open the specified HTTPS page in a temporary background tab in the selected container

output.page: bounded title, text and visible player metadata

media download.authorization: Open the specified HTTPS page in a temporary background tab in the selected container and save one unambiguous direct video to a new local file

xhs note upload.authorization: Upload ordered images to a blank creator page for human review
xhs note upload.output: images-ready with image count, or upload progress

xhs note fill.authorization: Fill missing title and body fields on the pinned uploaded note; preserve different existing values
xhs note fill.output: review-ready or review-incomplete with separate image, title, body and publish-control checks

installationLifecycle.install: Resolve current Agent exact Skill target; run skill install --agent NAME --target PATH; load Skill through host discovery.
installationLifecycle.update: Run selected Skill runtime update install --agent NAME --target PATH --yes; verify returned activated entry and refresh host discovery.
installationLifecycle.verification: Verify CLI and Skill versions, managed hashes, current=true and recovery.required=false; host loads installed SKILL.md independently.

automaticUpdates.trigger: containers list, containers inspect and session request task entry, sycm run, sycm mutation plan/apply, sycm open
automaticUpdates.configuration: Stable latest channel; detection only. Explicit update activates only the selected target runtime and Skill together.
automaticUpdates.recovery: Offline checks retain installed runtime; local edit/ownership conflicts stop replacement; prior target kept as backup. Use recorded candidate and inspect target status before retrying.

compatibility.agents: Any Agent with terminal, Node.js and Skill discovery capabilities; generic adapter
compatibility.macos: Native container list, account inspection and authorized session GET verified on macOS arm64 Ecom Dev; host discovery is checked separately
compatibility.windows: Package mechanics only; browser transport unsupported
compatibility.historicalUpdater: Actual published 0.1.1, 0.1.2, 0.1.3 and 0.2.0 updater entries verified with real npm, preserved prior versions, isolated targets and failure recovery

businessIntegration.verification: Transport availability is separate from per-endpoint live acceptance; inspect each operation schema. Plans authorize a workflow, not an executed submission.
businessIntegration.serviceRuntimeAcceptance: pending native build and per-service live checks
businessIntegration.containerBinding: Stable Ecom container ID, browser-owned session and native account verification; no separate Chrome store profile

pageFallback.strategy: Native HTTP and private auth initialization first. Open the registered container entry only when needed and authorized; verify data again afterward.

tabEditProtection.hadUserEdits: boolean when available; includes contenteditable edits
tabEditProtection.beforeUnloadDialogPossible: boolean; listener plus sticky user activation

restorationQueue.scope: current profile; background restore requests, not arbitrary website navigations or fresh page-task tabs
restorationQueue.history: active/queued requests plus bounded completed records
restorationQueue.queuedActionLookup: memory operation includes currentRestore; snapshots include tab.restore and top-level restoration
